BiblicalUsage: Jasiel the Mezobaite stands in the list of David's mighty men. Jaasiel the son of Abner was the ruler of Benjamin in David's reign.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two must not be folded into one: the Mezobaite fought among the mighty men and the son of Abner governed Benjamin, and the Bible gives each man his own verse.
